rationale: Glucose is the primary fermentable carbon source in excess. Heterofermentative glucose metabolism produces lactate, acetate, and CO2. Growth rate of 0.30/h is supported by 8 mmol/gDW/h glucose uptake with 30% biomass yield. Nitrogen from ammonium is non-limiting. Carbon balance verified: 48 mmol C in = 18 (lactate) + 6 (acetate) + 12 (CO2) + 9 (biomass) = 45 mmol C out.
